titleStmt.title: Kephalaia of the Teacher, edition page 33: diplomatic and Leiden transcription

sourceDesc.bibl: Kephalaia (Manichäische Handschriften der Staatlichen Museen Berlin), ed. H. J. Polotsky and A. Böhlig, Stuttgart: Kohlhammer, 33. Restorations, sublinear dots, gap counts and corrections are the editors'.

encodingDesc.p: EpiDoc. Read by eye from the page image; gap counts, sublinear dots and supralinear stroke extents verified by measurement on the image. A supralinear stroke is marked on every letter it covers by at least half its width. Spaces are the edition's word division. Facsimile zones are measured line centres. The editors' German statements are not transcribed: each is mapped to an id of the controlled vocabulary data/kephalaia/editorial_vocabulary.json and carried as @ana (ed: statements in the text, app: apparatus footnotes, tr: categories of the transcriber's commentary).

div.p: The framed manuscript page number ⲗⲅ is printed with a bar above and below as the frame, not as a supralinear stroke. Measured stroke over ϩⲛ of ⲉⲧϩⲛ (1000–1019, pixel row): ϩ 52 %, ⲛ 53 %, encoded on both; strokes over ⲛ of ⲛϩⲟⲩⲟ (539–552) and ⲣ of ϣⲃⲣ (738–750).
Measured stroke over ⲛⲛ of ⲛⲛϭⲁⲙ (659–677, pixel row): ⲛ 50 %, ⲛ 53 %, encoded on both.
Measured overline over ⲡⲛⲁ of ⲡⲡⲛⲁ (639–684): second ⲡ 84 %, ⲛ 100 %, ⲁ 58 %. The first ⲛ of ⲛⲛⲁⲡⲕⲉⲕⲉ carries both a sublinear dot and a stroke (812–825).
Measured stroke over ⲙⲛ (845–866, pixel row): ⲙ 52 %, ⲛ 57 %, encoded on both.
Measured stroke over ϩⲛ (776–796, pixel row): ϩ 56 %, ⲛ 60 %, encoded on both.
Line in ekthesis with an enlarged ⲡ.
Measured stroke over ⲛⲛ of ⲛⲛⲁⲣⲭⲱⲛ (657–676, pixel row): ⲛ 53 %, ⲛ 57 %, encoded on both.

A round dot (x ≈ 711, y ≈ 744, area 9) is printed above the second ⲧ of ⲡⲉⲧⲧϯⲡⲉ, between the lines (6× zoom). The footnote calls it a deletion point ("Tilgungspunkt") and reads ⲡⲉ ⲧϯⲡⲉ; the ⲧ is encoded as deleted by the scribe. The edition prints no double brackets. The stroke over ϫ of ⲉⲧϩⲁⲙϫ is printed obliquely.
Measured stroke over ⲙⲛ (947–967, pixel row): ⲙ 50 %, ⲛ 53 %, encoded on both.

Measured overline over ⲡⲛⲁ of ⲟⲩⲡⲛⲁ (650–695): covers ⲡ, ⲛ and ⲁ (58 %), not ⲩ. Measured stroke over ϩⲛ (1087–1107, pixel row): ϩ 56 %, ⲛ 60 %, encoded on both.

A small solid rectangle (x ≈ 1175–1184, y ≈ 1095–1110) stands after ⲉⲧϩⲁⲥϫⲏϥ at the line end; it is not a letter and is not encoded.
Measured stroke over ϩⲛ (563–583, pixel row): ϩ 56 %, ⲛ 60 %, encoded on both. Measured overline over ⲡⲛⲁ of ⲡⲉϥⲡⲛⲁ (815–860).
The first ⲙ of ⲙⲙⲡⲛⲁ carries a sublinear dot and its own stroke (611–624); the second ⲙ has its own stroke (632–645); the overline over ⲡⲛⲁ (653–698) covers ⲡ 84 %, ⲛ 100 %, ⲁ 55 %.

The ϣ of ⲙⲙⲁⲛⲟⲩⲱϣⲧ has a separate sublinear dot in its lower bowl (8× zoom; the ϣ of ⲛϣⲓⲥⲙⲉ on the same line has none). All other ϣ on the page were checked at 6× (ll. 1, 16, 17, 21); none has a dot. Measured stroke over ⲙⲛ (937–958, pixel row): ⲙ 55 %, ⲛ 57 %, encoded on both; stroke over the first ⲙ of ⲙⲙⲁⲛⲟⲩⲱϣⲧ (633–646).
